title: Peace & Cotton V2
subtitle: Website Design and Shopify Integration
details:
Jeremy, the owner of Peace & Cotton, wanted to transform their digital presence into a more contemporary redesign. The fresh look showcases their eco-conscious products through a minimalist interface and intuitive navigation.

Jeremy wanted the website to embody the same philosophy that drives their business, so we crafted a site that feels authentic to their brand—simple and natural. The new platform communicates their sustainable design, printing, and manufacturing capabilities while creating an experience that resonates with environmentally-conscious consumers.
